title: Defy Advanced SL 1 (2026)
notes: Official 2026 UK exact-trim page and specification support the Advanced SL-grade Composite frame, integrated seatpost, full-composite OverDrive Aero steerer, SRAM Force AXS E1 2x12 build, SLR 0 40 carbon wheels, 700x32C CADEX tires, 40 mm maximum tire size, fender mounts, sizes and geometry. They give no claimed complete weight, exact fiber/lay-up detail or stiffness result and do not establish mainland price, stock or warranty. Mapping the public-post bike to this generation remains unresolved.
